eventDetail.scope: The conference will serve as a premier platform for exchanging ideas, presenting research findings, and fostering collaborations that address real-world challenges through AI-driven solutions. OAIC  will focus on both theoretical developments and practical applications of AI across diverse domains such as healthcare, energy systems, smart cities, agriculture, communication networks, and industrial automation. The conference also emphasizes ethical AI, sustainable development, and the integration of AI with emerging technologies to drive societal and economic transformation.
